title: LOVE THIS APP
body: I have found that this app has a diverse set of features, you can customise the background, change image, play sounds and even play an arrangement of soft music and so much more! all for free, there is stuff that can be unlocked if you do a monthly/yearly subscription but you could also pay for a lifetime membership which is also pretty decent and you’d save so much money in the long run. You can also set reminders to do your goal and watch your flower grow each time you’ve completed it your task and every time you go into the app they have a new quote that you could also save as an image that has its own little features. Sorry for the ramble I just really wanted to put all the great stuff about the app in this review and I know I missed a few things but I did my best. Download the app! You won’t regret it!!

title: Very enjoyable!
body: I’ve been looking for a simple yet aesthetically pleasing and fun habit tracker. After trying 2 other apps, I searched the App Store even deeper until I found Eden. Curious about how it worked, I paid for a month and added some habits to give it a god go. Needless to say, it’s been less than 2 weeks and I’m already considering buying the lifetime subscription. I love watching the garden grow every day that I tick my habits off. The calming sounds and music are also lovely to hear. Despite all of this simplistic and beautiful features, I would like more ways to count progress, for example, I’d like to read 10 pages daily and have a way to manually add the total of pages I have read (10, 22, etc) and to have a way to add more pages to this as my day progresses. Food for thought, otherwise very good for very simple done/ not done habits.

title: Not for me
body:
I bought this one a little too soon I think, I wish I had waited to use it a while before spending money on it because it’s become clear it’s not for me. 

Goals all collect on the one page even if they’re not relevant to the day, making everything feel cluttered. You only see progress in your garden when you achieve every goal for the day and mark the final one off, but miss just one and your progress takes a hit and you immediately go backwards. I don’t find any motivation in this structure and instead started feeling guilty and demotivated, which I guess might work for some people but not for me. 

I don’t like the way goals are structured; I’d like more flexibility for day to day things that won’t necessarily repeat, or at least a separate tab which only shows my goals relevant to that day (instead of just fading the irrelevant ones out). 

Essentially just feels like a list I could have made in my notes app. Really disappointed, especially given it looks like it’s been around for a few years now.

I will say I didn’t find it buggy at all and it’s aesthetically pleasing, it’s just not at all what I’m after in an app that’s supposed to help motivate me to keep my habits/tasks on track.
